tools.name: find
tools.description: Find plumbers for a job in San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley and the Tri-Valley (Danville, San Ramon, Dublin, Pleasanton, Livermore), ranked by the chance they keep every promise that matters for it: take the job, have a slot in the window, quote within budget, arrive on time, hold the quote, finish,

tools.name: book
tools.description: Book a plumber from a find (business_id + find_id). Version 1 is a handoff: Tallyho records the request and returns the plumber's phone number and the questions to ask; nothing is booked until the user calls, so booked is false. Don't send the user's contact details on a handoff; they are never stor

tools.name: report
tools.description: Report on a booking, by booking_id, from any session. After the call to the plumber: result confirmed, declined or not_booked, plus the quote (price, slot). After the job: completed, not_completed, no_show or a cancellation, plus the final price and arrival time. Verdicts per promise are kept, broke

tools.name: status
tools.description: Read a booking as it stands, by booking_id, from any session; holding the booking_id is enough. Works on every booking, handoff ones too. On a booking Tallyho is calling about, status moves from requested to confirmed, counter, declined, not_booked or pending: call status again after check_after_s s

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find · Private data: find, book, status · Public sink: book.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find · Private data: find, book, status · Public sink: book

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
